hypotheses.claim: A model-internal workspace-like representation plane and FRANK's system-level GWT should remain separately typed and separately instrumented; model-internal global availability does not establish system broadcast, receiver uptake, causal use, re-entry, or effect authority.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: A sufficiently capable local 4B can internalize enough workspace behavior that most explicit system-GWT machinery adds only overhead.
hypotheses.next_test: Freeze model output and compare EVENT_BUS, explicit receiver-causal WorkspaceEpisode, and model-internal-only baselines on matched H1 traces with receiver-use/outcome/re-entry receipts.

hypotheses.claim: Outcome/pressure-gated adaptive recurrence should outperform one fixed recurrence budget across heterogeneous FRANK tasks after accounting for latency and instability.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Ordinary persistent event-driven orchestration or a small fixed recurrence budget is equally effective and simpler.
hypotheses.next_test: Matched H1 replay: fixed depth, simple post-hoc trajectory readout, marginal-utility controller, and event-driven null under identical model outputs where technically meaningful.

hypotheses.claim: Incrementally maintained semantic dependency closures can make most FRANK hot reads local while preserving exact state if update amplification is explicitly bounded and measured.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: High-fanout semantic hubs cause enough invalidation amplification that simpler on-demand retrieval is competitive or safer.
hypotheses.next_test: Replay representative UnifiedDB/ClayGraph mutation traces and report affected-closure fraction, stale omission, false invalidation, latency, memory, and worst-hub amplification.

hypotheses.claim: Evidence-preserving, future-utility-weighted semantic backflow from strong peers to the local 4B will preserve future local behavior better per token than naive summaries or full-state truncation.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Retrieval-only references plus on-demand re-expansion are sufficient and materially cheaper.
hypotheses.next_test: Compare the seven backflow baselines already frozen in FRANK_FINAL_BINARY_RESEARCH_CONTRACT under fixed context/token budgets and provider-loss episodes.

hypotheses.claim: Frontend/semantic closure state must be bound to executable, versioned receipts; a narrative CLOSED status is insufficient when the expected current receipt is absent or an independent runtime discriminator conflicts with it.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: The missing receipt is only a publication lag and current V7 passes its pinned strict runtime unchanged.
hypotheses.next_test: Run tools/claycode_strict_lalr_probe.py and tools/claycode_v7_frontend_identity_regression.py on current main with the workflow-pinned lark[interegular]==1.3.1, persist receipts, then adjudicate CC-DEFECT-P1-001/002 and CC-WP-02 from those receipts.
